name: muscular dystrophy-dystroglycanopathy (congenital with brain and eye anomalies), type A, 4
description: Fukuyama type muscular dystrophy (FCMD) is a congenital progressive muscular dystrophy characterized by brain malformation (cobblestone lissencephaly), dystrophic changes in skeletal muscle, severe intellectual deficit, epilepsy and motor impairment.
